row_semantics: Each row represents a specific command or mode related to the interior lighting system, particularly for rear door lamps (DoorRR3Lamp and DoorRR4Lamp). The rows define different operational states, timing parameters, and control signals for these lights.

column_semantics.Input: The leftmost column lists the input commands or modes (e.g., DoorRR3LampFadeSpdCmd_1, DoorRR4LampOnOff_1).
column_semantics.LIN: Indicates the LIN bus interface for communication.
column_semantics.RHZCU: Refers to the Rear High Zone Control Unit, a central controller for the lighting system.
column_semantics.DoorAmbtLampD_RR: Specifically refers to the ambient lamp driver for the right rear door.
column_semantics.RHZCU_LIN4: Another LIN channel used by the RHZCU for this sub-system.
column_semantics.内灯SSTS: Internal lighting sub-system technical specification, indicating the scope of the table.

core_timing_constraints.name: Breathing Cycle

core_timing_constraints.name: Fade Speed
core_timing_constraints.description: Spd1 (300ms), Spd2 (100ms), and Spd3 (reserved) define the time required for the lamp to transition between brightness levels.
